metadata.title: Realt AI — Make better housing decisions
metadata.description: Realt AI is an intelligent decision assistant that helps you understand your priorities, weigh trade-offs, and confidently choose the right home.

footer.tagline: Realt AI helps you understand your priorities before you look at properties.

hero.heading: Looking for a new home? You've found the right place.
hero.paragraph1: Whether you want to rent an apartment, buy your first house or find a place to start over, Realt AI helps you through the whole housing journey. Explore new possibilities, discover areas that fit your lifestyle and get help finding a home that feels right for you — not just on paper, but in everyday life.
hero.paragraph2: And the best part? Realt AI is completely free for people looking for a home. No hidden fees, no paid upgrades and no extra costs. We are here to help you find the right place — and it should not cost you anything.

about.heading: About us
about.p1: Realt AI is an AI-driven housing intelligence company built to transform how people discover, evaluate and choose their next home.
about.p2: Originally created to help students and young adults find housing that fits their finances, education and lifestyle, we recognized that these challenges extend across the entire housing market.
about.p3: Our platform uses AI to understand individual needs, analyze housing opportunities and connect people with relevant housing providers, including real estate agencies, property companies and housing platforms.
about.p4: We are a Free B2B2C Agentic SaaS (Software as a Service). Our service is and will remain 100% free for users. We generate revenue through business partnerships and companies seeking relevant visibility, never by charging people to find a home.
about.p5: Our vision is global: making smarter housing decisions accessible to everyone, everywhere.
about.tagline: Realt AI — A smarter way to find where you belong.

how.heading: How does Realt AI work?
how.subheading: Most search tools show you homes. Realt AI starts with you: it learns what matters, weighs it honestly and explains every recommendation.

describe.title: Understands you in plain language
describe.description: Write the way you talk. Realt AI reads budget, commute, space, lifestyle and deal-breakers from your own words and turns them into a structured profile.

weights.title: Learns what matters most
weights.description: Not every wish weighs the same. Your priorities become weights, so the things you care about most steer the result.

conflicts.title: Spots conflicts before you do
conflicts.description: When two wishes pull in opposite directions, Realt AI tells you up front and helps you choose, instead of pretending you can have everything.

score.description: Each home gets a match score built from your weighted priorities, with the reasons for and against shown, so there are no black boxes.

finalCta.heading: So what are you waiting for? Find your dream home.
finalCta.paragraph1: It takes just a few minutes to tell Realt AI what matters to you. Write in your own words, answer a couple of quick questions and see how your priorities shape the homes that fit you best.
finalCta.paragraph2: And once again: Realt AI is completely free for people looking for a home. No hidden fees, no paid upgrades, no catch. There is no good reason not to try it. The worst that can happen is that you understand your own priorities a little better, and the best is that you find the place where you belong.

analysis.title: Personalized AI Analysis
analysis.subtitle: Housing decisions, built around you.
analysis.p1: Realt AI analyses your individual needs, budget, lifestyle and personal priorities to help you discover housing options that genuinely fit your life. Through an intelligent, conversational analysis, Realt AI learns what matters most to you — from location and affordability to space, comfort and everyday convenience.
analysis.p2: Beyond simply understanding your preferences, Realt AI helps identify potential compromises, competing priorities and factors you may not have considered. By turning complex housing requirements into clear insights, we help you understand your options, make informed decisions and feel more confident throughout your housing journey.

area.title: Area Exploration
area.subtitle: Discover the life around your next home.
area.p1: Finding the right home is about more than the property itself. The surrounding area plays an equally important role in shaping your everyday life. With Area Exploration, Realt AI helps you discover what living in a particular location could actually look like.
area.p2: Explore nearby restaurants, gyms, grocery stores, parks, public transport and other essential services directly through an interactive map. Understand distances, discover useful places and get a broader perspective of the neighbourhood before making a decision.
area.p3: By bringing the surrounding environment into your housing search, Realt AI helps you evaluate not only where you could live, but also how well that location fits your lifestyle, routines and daily needs.

matching.title: Smarter Housing Matching
matching.subtitle: Less searching. More meaningful matches.
matching.p1: Realt AI goes beyond traditional housing filters by evaluating properties according to your individual needs, preferences and priorities. Instead of simply showing you listings that match a set of search criteria, our AI analyses how well each housing option aligns with the way you want to live.
matching.p2: Each recommendation is designed to help you understand why a particular property may be a good fit, highlighting relevant advantages, potential disadvantages and important factors to consider. You can compare different options based on what matters most to you, rather than getting lost in endless listings.
matching.p3: The result is a more focused and intelligent housing search, where every recommendation has a purpose — helping you spend less time searching and more time discovering a place that truly feels right.

draftNotice.title: Draft — not yet reviewed by legal counsel
draftNotice.body: This page describes what Realt AI actually does today, as accurately as we can state it. It has not been reviewed by a qualified lawyer and should not be treated as a final, binding policy until it has. Do not rely on it for a public launch without legal review, particularly for compliance with the GDPR.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Realt AI collects, why, and what choices you have.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Realt AI ([legal entity name to be added]) operates this site as an AI-first housing decision assistant. For questions about this policy or your data, contact [privacy contact email to be added].

sections.heading: What information we collect
paragraphs: The free-text description of your housing priorities that you type into the onboarding flow, and the structured priorities derived from it (budget, commute, bedrooms and bathrooms, must-haves, deal-breakers, and lifestyle preferences).
Your selected language and theme preference.

Standard technical data such as your IP address, used only to apply rate limits that protect the service from abuse. This is currently held only in server memory for a short rolling window and is not stored permanently.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: To operate the core feature of the product: understanding your priorities and generating explainable property matches.

If an AI provider is configured, the free-text description you provide may be sent to OpenAI, L.L.C. (a third-party AI provider based in the United States) to extract structured priorities from it. Realt AI instructs this provider not to use API inputs to train its models. If no AI provider is configured, priorities are extracted entirely on our own server, without any third party involved.

sections.heading: Where your information is stored
paragraphs: At this stage of development, Realt AI does not operate a persistent database. The priorities you enter are held only in your browser's session storage for the duration of your visit, and are not stored on Realt AI's servers beyond the time needed to process a single request.
This will change as account and saved-search features are introduced. This policy will be updated, and made clearly current, before any such feature is launched.

sections.heading: Legal basis for processing (GDPR)
paragraphs: Where the GDPR applies, we process the information described above on the basis of your consent, given by choosing to describe your priorities to us, and our legitimate interest in operating and securing the service, such as rate limiting.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or receive a copy of your data, and to object to certain processing. If the GDPR applies to you, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority — in Sweden, Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (IMY).
Because Realt AI does not currently retain your data beyond your browsing session, most of these rights are already satisfied by default. Contact us if you have any questions.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: Realt AI uses a small number of strictly necessary technologies: a cookie to remember your selected language, and browser session storage to carry your priorities from the intake flow to your recommendations.
Realt AI does not currently use analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies. If that changes, this policy will be updated and consent will be requested where required.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Realt AI is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16 years old.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will update this page as the product evolves, particularly once accounts, persistent storage, or new data sources are introduced.

terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Realt AI.

sections.heading: Acceptance of these terms
paragraphs: By using Realt AI, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: What Realt AI is
paragraphs: Realt AI is a decision-support tool that helps you think through your housing priorities and see explainable, transparent property matches. Realt AI is not a licensed real estate broker, agent, appraiser, or financial, legal, or tax advisor, and nothing in the service constitutes such advice.

sections.heading: Accuracy of information
paragraphs: During this development phase, the properties shown in Realt AI are illustrative example data and do not represent real, currently available listings. This section will be revised once Realt AI is connected to a real property data source.
Match scores are generated from the priorities you provide and are intended to support, not replace, your own judgment and professional advice.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
paragraphs: You agree to provide accurate information and not to misuse the service — for example, by attempting to overwhelm it with automated requests. The service applies rate limits to protect it for everyone.

sections.heading: Intellectual property

sections.heading: Disclaimer of warranties

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, Realt AI is not liable for decisions made based on its recommendations, or for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.
